reviews.t: It's a tint, not full coverage.
reviews.x: Bought this on Amazon to try first. It does stain really good! If you just want a hint of color to enhance your lip color, its perfect! It is not a full coverage lipstick on me! No regrets on this purchase!

reviews.t: It really works! But only at first.
reviews.x: UPDATE: it’s been a little over a month and this has definitely stopped working as well. There’s plenty left in the tube (I use it 2-3 days per week) and it goes on fine. However, when I spritz the fixative, the color bleeds a bit into my skin. It does wipe off. And then last night during dinner I noticed it wiping off onto my white napkin about 2hrs after application. By 6hrs later it was completely gone. Really disappointed and won’t be buying it again. reviews.t: They got the color right this time!
reviews.x: I ordered the color Romance and though the formula is a little thinner, it works. Nice, reddish lips, no flaking/fading, and it's still as easy to apply and use as the XoXo.  This one is going on my trip with me.  Pro Tips:  leave on for about 2 minutes for full color saturation.  Hold the spray at least six inches from your face or the color will bleed from too much spray.  Press your lips together and wipe softly with a paper towel or tissue to remove the blue. I have vitiligo of the lips and is in constant search of a semi permanent cover up. This does the trick. I will try different shades to find a more natural look but I’m over all pleased. Great value for money and very easy to use. Lasted me about 2 days. But I’m very self conscious so I constantly apply lip balm and moisturizer so that could have affected the longevity. I believe it’s worth buying. Give it a try for yourself.

I’m glad I got this product. It comes with the lip color (I ordered Romance) and the activator. I also ordered the lip gloss separately and I definitely recommend it. I’m not super makeup savvy but I do wear it, except lipstick because it comes off and I talk a lot at work and can’t really reapply. I’ve only used this once so far and I think with practice it will be just perfect. It was hard to get 2-3 coats on quickly and evenly my first time. It’s easy to use, and depending on how long you leave it on, you can achieve a darker deeper color. I left it on the first time for 45 seconds and got a pretty and natural color that lasted all day - 12 hours. reviews.x: I don't typically wear a lot of make up so was excited to try this to get a bit of color without a lot of work. I'm 50 and have trouble with a lot of lipsticks "bleeding" into the fine lines around my lips. This still does that to some extent so you need to make sure you use the activator very sparingly. If you eat or drink at all, it really does fade badly but if not, it will last for HOURS. I actually experimented before bed last night. Put it on right before I brushed my teeth and it was stil

I hate it when I am wearing a lipstick and it comes off on glasses, food, etc. This stays on and lasts all day! I put it on at 6:30 am, went to work all day, and it still looked fabulous by the time I had an interview at 6:00pm! It's amazing and I had to get a second color! Whimsical is my favorite though.  note: I did notice that it was gone by 10:00 pm.

So I use it once a week for when I go to campus. It’s been around 2 months. I would say I used it 10-11 times and my bottle is already empty. It takes way longer than 30-45 seconds to set. I usually leave it on for 5-10 minutes or else the color doesn’t come in. I use Romance so it’s a darker color too yet it doesn’t show unless I wait. It’s pretty expensive for what I get to use. The peel is not easy to peel, maybe because I wait longer. But the spray makes it moist and it should still come off

My daughter recommended Wonderskin; she loves it, and it looks fantastic on her (she's 38).  I tried it several times, but sadly, though it worked on my lower lip, it didn't work at all on my upper lip (I'm 68).  Sigh.  I'm sure it has something to do with aging lips, but I'll have to stick to regular lipstick.

Use a lot of gloss; as little spray as possible…don’t spray close. You won’t get a perfect peel like the ad shows, some will need to be wiped off. NBD. reviews.t: Great color payoff in a longER wearing lipcolor
reviews.x: I purchased the kit in three different colors, and Romance has definitely been my favorite. I'm on the pale side, and this color reads berry red on my skin. Application is just like any other liquid lip color, but there's definitely a learning curve with the activator. Too much, and it will bleed from under the peel away but and you'll end up looking like you ate a rapidly melting popsicle. reviews.t: Not as long lasting as advertised
reviews.x: I got this product hoping for a long lasting lip stain so I wouldn’t have to reapply lipstick through out the day, but unfortunately this thing is not good proof. It’s a great color and is easy to peel, but unfortunately it just doesn’t stay on all day. And it’s too much work to reapply through out the day.

Ordered wonderskin because regular lipstick just goes all over my face after a while and comes off so easy. I just need something that has a little color and looks nice without me constantly having to check that it is. I did as suggested as exfoliated my lips and then patted with a wet tissue before applying. Two quick coats and the spray and so far I like it! I applied a little CarMax when it was dry so we will see how it wears, I work outside in the Midwest so that will be the real test. I'll

It works best for me if I exfoliate the CRAP out of my lips and then put a thin layer on for about 15-20 seconds. If you let it sit for too long before spraying, it is uneven. I got the colors Romance and Whimsical. This is PERFECT for someone like me who doesn’t like to devote too much time to make up but still wants to look cute!

Color purchased is “Romance” Loved this!! Lasted all day and night on a weekend Vegas trip!! Perfect lip color for that type of weekend. Suggestion…take tissue, cut a hole the size of your lips to cover your face so that you can spray the activator without messing up your makeup. Best stuff ever!! Want it in every color!!!

I received this yesterday and immediately tried it. Oh my gosh I am so impressed. I have tried lip stains before which totally dry my lips out. This? My lips don't feel like there's anything on them, they're moist they look perfectly pink and they feel really good. I woke up this morning and they were still looking amazing!  I immediately ordered another color and I am telling all my friends about this. It's amazing and I love it!

reviews.t: Not Worth the Money, Acid Spray?
reviews.x: Despite exfoliation goes on uneven, staining darker towards the inside of the mouth than around the perimeter.  The spray appears to be some kind of acid; really made me wonder about what inevitably ended up inside my mouth.  The color lasted only about 5 hours.

The color I got was Romance… it is not even close to the same color I thought I was getting. Looks good so far. I just put it on when it came in so we will see how it holds up… still mad that this color is a lot darker than what I was wanting.

very disappointed. Color lasted maybe an hour if that. Colors were way to light, and it ran. It is nothing at all like the ad  I truly feel as though my money should be REFUNDED. I foolishly purchased 2 colors.  DO NOT PURCHASE THIS PRODUCTS
This lipstick is fun! This color gets pinker the longer I leave it on. I prefer just a slight tint of color, so I apply it then after about 5 seconds I wipe it off.
Definitely brighter and a different color than anticipated even though I only left it on for 10-15 seconds. But the color is still pretty
Turned my top and bottom lips different colors. Was not as long wearing as advertised. Very drying.

Product was easy to apply. Made 3 applications but the spray that you use to activate the product sprayed out red and it dropped down my face like a vampire.  Product did not peel off like video and using the wipe included made my lips burn and irritated.  Lip color stain was not bright and barley there. The girls in that video must have applied thick thick layers and left it on for a long time.  Once I started to eat or anything other than water touched my lips the color started to smear off.

reviews.t: Long lasting color! Not a regular lipstick
reviews.x: This is not a regular lipstick. It comes in a very modern and shiny package that makes a nice gift, but might not be suitable for sensitive skin. There are three steps to use the product: applying the color, spraying a product to set it, and then peel off the film that forms on the lips, leaving a lip color that does not stain masks or cups, and stays on for hours. I think it is handy for special occasions, but too much trouble for everyday use. I'm happy with the results, though.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the product provides long-lasting, all-day color that stays put better than regular lipstick.
Several reviewers note it is a tint rather than full coverage, and some say it does not last as long as advertised.
Reviewers frequently mention a learning curve with application, especially with the activator spray, and advise following directions carefully.
Some reviewers report issues with bleeding into fine lines or uneven results, particularly with too much activator or leaving it on too long.
A few reviewers note the product works less well on aging lips or upper lips, and one mentions it tastes bad.
